summary: Stamp-book/guide window that loads the stamp_page / stamp_msg / stamp_reward BXON tables and builds the page row widgets.
evidence: Ui_StampBookWindow_Ctor (0x36A640) loads the three stamp BXON tables through func_00124E5C and builds the page parts; the dtor (0x36B248) releases five part handles and the page list. Most batch field lines for this class actually read BXON resource objects, not self, so several fields stay unknown.
